cases.rationale: Assumes a sharp deceleration from the interim earnings run-rate and multiple compression consistent with memory-cycle and execution risk.
Assumes fiscal-year earnings retain much of the reported interim strength while allowing for moderation after record fiscal Q3 results.
Assumes strategic customer agreements and AI-memory demand sustain strong earnings and a higher valuation assumption.

assumptions: Scenario sensitivity, not consensus or an observed company multiple. FY2026 GAAP annual EPS assumptions are anchored to FY2025 reported diluted EPS of $7.59 and the reported 273-day FY2026 interim diluted EPS of $41.40; these inputs are not an annualization. Bear/base/bull multiples of 18x/22x/26x are explicit assumptions, held beyond the 63-session horizon solely to frame sensitivity. Dated price is split-adjusted; scenario EPS assumptions are declared split-adjusted for comparability.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
